Aisha Khan: Quick — drafting a short customer RCA + mitigation note for the onboarding tenants affected by yesterday's ingest delay. Plan: send targeted to high-touch first, then broadcast. Draft in 20m for review.

Marcos Rivera: Start with a brief apology and exact UTC window. Add SLA language: define 'impacted' (records lost/need backfill) vs 'degraded' (slower but complete). Call out credit calc (overage fees during outage window). Keep it short.

Lena Chen: SRE short: malformed protobuf bypassed validation, triggering retry loops that backed up ingest queues. Remediation: schema validation gate + rate-limited replays. Window: 2026-03-22 03:10:12Z — 03:48:09Z.

Jae Park: For renewal-risk customers (> $5k ARR in onboarding) recommend 1:1 outreach, a complimentary enablement session, and a one-month ingestion credit. Uploading list now.

Aisha Khan: Draft email: "Hi {{first_name}},
We're sorry — on March 22 between 03:10 and 03:48 UTC some onboarding ingestion jobs for a subset of customers were delayed. We fixed the root cause, completed prioritized backfills, and added safeguards to prevent recurrence.
What we did:
• Blocked malformed protobufs with a schema validation gate.
• Rate-limited replays to avoid downstream spikes.
• Completed prioritized backfills — open a ticket if you still see missing records.
What you'll get:
• Ingestion overage fees incurred during the outage window will be credited.
• High-touch onboarding customers will receive an additional one-month platform credit and an invite to a dedicated enablement session.
Reply to request a 1:1 walkthrough.
Sincerely,
Aisha Khan, Customer Success"

Marcos Rivera: Approve credit wording. Keep public status short and link to internal RCA.

IncidentBot: Incident INGEST-874 detected 2026-03-22T03:10:12Z, resolved 2026-03-22T03:48:09Z. Postmortem draft: https://redwood-internal/pg/INGEST-874/postmortem

Aisha Khan: Final: targeted sends in 15m, two office hours (APAC + EMEA/AMER), attach short RCA, file customer copies on the incident page, and loop Sales for renewal follow-up. Thanks team.
